decision.explanation: Both documents provide direct evidence for Yuriy Sarantsev’s citizenship. Document D1S3 states he was 'born and raised within the Soviet borders,' linking his identity to the Soviet Union. Document D2S19 explicitly declares, 'He was, in every sense of the word, a citizen of this great nation [the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland].' These are distinct valid referents and complementary answers, not contradictory, as they describe different stages of his life and national affiliations.
